bio.text: Grace Lee has represented the 65th Assembly District in Lower Manhattan, including the Financial District, Chinatown and the Lower East Side, since taking office in 2023.
According to her Assembly biography, she is the first Korean American woman elected to the New York State Legislature, and she lives in Lower Manhattan.
She holds a BA from Columbia University and an MBA from the University of Chicago Booth School of Business.

Ballotpedia lists her as the Democratic and Working Families Party candidate for New York State Senate District 27 in the November 3, 2026 general election, rather than for re-election to the Assembly.
